_README: The AI merge policy for outside pull requests (open-source plan, #552; #626).
ON since Paul's go-public trigger (2026-11-12). deploy-gate.yml soaks a range
with an outside commit on staging before production. A PR off the allowlist
is rebuilt by the orchestrator with credit (Git Crafter skills/merging/outside.md).
Only the orchestrator merges, at the head SHA
the checker printed (gh pr merge N --merge --match-head-commit <sha>).
One definition: 04_tools/merge_policy.py reads this file. content-gates.yml
runs its self-test; the orchestrator's review calls it on an outside PR
(REVIEW.md, Outside PR paths).
Default deny. An outside PR is AI-mergeable only when every changed path
(old and new names of a rename included) matches ai_mergeable and none
matches maintainer_only. Anything else waits for a maintainer.
maintainer_only wins over ai_mergeable. It names what runs at build or deploy
time or defines the gates, the BRIEF section 4 shared files, personal and
legal data, and every AI disclosure surface (.claude/rules/ai-disclosure.md),
which needs a person's check in review.
Every ai_mergeable glob starts with a literal folder or file name: '**', '*'
and '**/*' are refused, so the file cannot grant everything.
AI-mergeable also needs green required checks on the head commit and a pass
from both the code-review and the security-review agents; the checker
answers only the path question. Agents never approve a PR.
Samples: ai_mergeable must exit 0; maintainer_only must be blocked by a
maintainer_only glob; default_deny must be blocked by missing the allowlist;
refused holds malformed paths. --self-test runs them all, plus the bad
policies in merge_policy_fixtures/. Change a glob, add a sample.
